name: configure_recording_permission
title: Configure recording permission
description: Explicitly request one local macOS recording permission or open its fixed privacy settings pane on the server host, without starting a recording or creating a meeting, track or job. Requires a resident server so the connected server's recorder and recording lock are used; product CLI in-process fallback is forbidden. This action never grants permission automatically, resets TCC, or accepts arbitrary URLs or commands. A denied OS request is a successful result containing the remaining permission state. settings_opened only means the OS accepted opening settings, not that permission was granted. A successful replay with the same request_id returns the original snapshot; reuse an ID only with identical arguments. Concurrent in-flight requests, including the same ID, fail immediately with busy rather than running later. After an uncertain response, inspect get_server_info with refresh_permissions=true and permission_setup_in_progress from the same server_instance_id observed before the action; a different or missing identity does not prove the earlier helper exited. Do not automatically retry the mutation. The recorder action has a 120-second deadline and owned-child cleanup. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: busy, invalid_argument, recorder_unavailable, internal.

settings_opened.description: True only when the OS accepted opening the fixed privacy settings pane or its privacy-root fallback. This is not a permission grant.
